resolved.title: 字符串
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Strings[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

A [b]String [/b]is an object that represents a sequence of characters.
For example, "Hello" is a string of 5 characters.

[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="java" ][b]String [/b]s = "SoloLearn"; [/code]
[note]You are allowed to define an empty string. For example, String str = "";[/note]
